skills.name: Agent Orchestra
skills.description: Design composable multi-agent topologies with isolation, adversarial review, and receipt-driven integration.

skills.name: Agent Collaboration Control
skills.description: Authority, evidence, liveness, and transition control for consequential multi-agent work.

skills.name: Grade-A Pipeline
skills.description: A test-sandwiched software pipeline with isolated worktrees and opt-in remote mutation.

skills.name: Plus Ultra
skills.description: A proposer-arbiter-reality-verifier discipline for consequential agent work.

skills.name: Visual QA
skills.description: Screenshot-first multi-agent review for defects text-only QA misses.

skills.name: Heimdall
skills.description: Turn browser and API checks into executable plans with assertions, screenshots, and structured results. Choose Playwright or an isolated container; cases requiring a real logged-in browser remain visibly blocked until exercised.

skills.name: Cross-Agent Sync
skills.description: Local-first deterministic context handoff between Claude Code, Codex, and shared agent workspaces.

skills.name: Argus
skills.description: Durable context routing and backlink validation for Git-backed knowledge systems.

skills.name: Chronicle
skills.description: Preserve observed work and the intent behind it, recover captured file versions, and explore the evidence in a local canvas. Capture coverage is explicit; model-inferred entries remain labelled.

skills.name: Archivum
skills.description: Operate a Git-backed knowledge workspace that keeps projects, decisions, sources, and evidence usable across conversations. Search before creating, preserve provenance, and resume from canonical records rather than chat fragments.

skills.name: Doppel
skills.description: A consent-first digital twin of your own writing voice, with local provenance and human publication authority.

skills.name: Beautiful PDF
skills.description: Print-ready PDF design with reusable CSS and a rendered-page visual review loop.

skills.name: Local UIs
skills.description: Discover locally running HTTP interfaces and open them from one private launcher.

skills.name: GCP Keyless
skills.description: Short-lived Google Cloud access through managed identity and GitHub OIDC federation.

skills.name: Bitwarden Lease
skills.description: An owner-only, in-memory Bitwarden CLI lease for local macOS agents.

skills.name: Mailbutler
skills.description: Narrative-aware, read-only inbox triage with prompt-injection defenses and separate approvals for drafting and sending.

skills.name: Threadseer
skills.description: Turn approved transcripts into traceable decisions, unresolved disagreements and next actions. Source anchors keep institutional memory connected to what was actually said.

skills.name: Doppel Gang
skills.description: Keep the author in charge while explicitly synthetic review lenses challenge the argument, evidence and wording. Optional Doppel-assisted drafting requires a separate request.

skills.name: Back to the Chronicle
skills.description: Reconstruct project history from explicitly selected session logs, Git and surviving files. Keep witnessed events, inferred intent and gaps separate; reconstruction cannot recover uncaptured bytes.

skills.name: Nexus
skills.description: Map an unfamiliar repository, trace the parts relevant to the task and build a source-cited context pack. A bundled mapper makes the first pass portable.

skills.name: ML Research Skeptical Audit
skills.description: Challenge an ML result at the code and experiment level: leakage, unfair comparisons, missing controls and claims that outrun evidence. An audit is not a completed reproduction.

skills.name: ML Run Provenance
skills.description: Make experiment records explain why a run exists and which code, data and settings produced it. Preserve run context at creation instead of reconstructing its meaning from a dashboard later.

skills.name: Propagate
skills.description: Identify where a reusable improvement belongs and which consumers need it. Review the propagation plan, apply only approved changes and verify each destination independently.

skills.name: Butler
skills.description: Give autonomous work a budget authority: inspect token estimates, account for GPU reservations and reconcile usage. The local cockpit starts empty; it is not a provider-enforced spending cap.

skills.name: Questlog
skills.description: Keep commitments, waiting-on states and one next action in a readable Markdown ledger. A local cockpit adds capture and review without taking authority over messages or calendar changes.

skills.name: Reconnect
skills.description: Find relevant peers, collaborators and communities, explain why they fit, and track explicitly authorised connections. A private ledger preserves evidence and prevents duplicate batches.

skills.name: Amber
skills.description: Preserve Claude Code and Codex session files in private snapshots. The portable runtime supports local or mounted sources, rejects unsafe paths and reports incomplete backups; it does not redact secrets from transcripts.

skills.name: Session Atlas
skills.description: Turn selected session history into a compact causal map with source-linked evidence. Index and validate private history while keeping remembered context separate from current authority.

skills.name: Pulse
skills.description: Give recurring agent checks an exact target, notification rule, authority boundary and stopping condition. Includes Meta-Pulse for reviewing duplicate or obsolete watches; requires the host scheduler.

skills.name: Davinci Mode
skills.description: Explore straightforward, hybrid and creative approaches with concrete tradeoffs and a reasoned recommendation. Keeps alternatives viable and stops reopening the decision once you choose.

skills.name: Experiment Framework
skills.description: Specify, plan and audit reproducible ML runs with source revisions, provenance and artifact links. Includes the runtime; remote execution needs configured providers, credentials and explicit budget authority.

skills.name: Transfer Consciousness
skills.description: Prepare a source-linked continuation brief and verify a single-owner handoff across hosts. Separates readiness, quiescence and ownership; instructions are not live process migration or a distributed lock.
